notes.title: Demo bug fixes
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone, 

Thank you for playing our demo! 
Also thank you for all your feedback both in bug reports and sharing your experience, it’s all been really insightful. Anyways, here's an update. It will be the only update for the demo for a while now. 

I couldn’t address every bug but I’ve addressed a lot and tweaked the balancing to be less gruelling. v0.31 Changes [/p][list][*][p]Starting Stamina increased,[/p][/*][*][p]AP now completely protects HP until broken,[/p][/*][*][p]Broken Needle replaced with entirely new weapon,[/p][/*][*][p]Animations Adjusted for Certain Weapons,[/p][/*][*][p]Parry Timing on all weapons adjusted,[/p][/*][*][p]Balance adjustments for “Champion”,[/p][/*][*][p]Lifesteal amount increased across all weapons,[/p][/*][*][p]Adrenaline Attack Boost increased whilst Defence Debuff is slightly decreased,[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted Stamina damage of enemies,[/p][/*][/list][p] Bug Fixes [/p][list][*][p]Camera overhauled,[/p][/*][*][p]Lock On Switching overhauled,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Main Menu Exit button,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing text,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Missing Deathplanes,[/p][/*][*][p]Unexpected visitor removed,[/p][/*][*][p]Failsafe provided if you trade lives with Champion before receiving their Key,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Spawn Float bug,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed ambience not correctly resetting upon reloading of level,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed buttress crash animation replaying on respawn,[/p][/*][/list][p] 
Lastly, if you haven’t already, you should join the discord! There’s 300 people in there now which is strange, but I try to peep in every now and then and share an update or whatever. [/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/7qwhs2UHhA"]https://discord.gg/7qwhs2UHhA[/url][/p][p] 
Thanks again! -Tammy[/p]

notes.title: Thank you!
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]Thanks for all your support on Prison of Husks! It’s surreal and cool seeing the response so far. 

I’m excited to show more in the future, it’s tough to decide what I can and can’t show because I want to retain as much of surprise for you in the full release. I hope to make PoH a neat little game. 

Thanks for all the feedback too, from goofy bugs to any design critique, it’s insightful and will prove helpful as I try to reflect, iterate and improve upon everything. 

Please enjoy my trailer for the IGN Live this weekend. 

Thanks again! -Tammy

[/p][previewyoutube="hcDVMPyN2J0;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Steam Demo Out
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone, 

We have a demo on Steam now! It was announced at the Future Games Live showcase alongside a brand-new trailer I made that shows new stuff like some areas and a boss... go watch it!

If you played any prior demo versions like on itch or Haunted PS1, this is similar, but here we’re locking down the game-feel. 

I’m open to hearing your thoughts and feedback! 

Regarding development so far, the world design is almost fully blocked out. Lots of areas need further iteration and stuff, but we’re feeling good about the layout and game progression. 
Numerous bosses have animations, designs laid out, and are in a prototype stage. It’s really just a lot of iteration, but we’ll get there in time! I’ll attach the new features list below this post. 

Thank you for your support, everyone :] -Tammy[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011274/52a226958bf2d1729bef80b344d1db282ae09106.png"][/img][/p][p]VICTORY BY ANY MEANS 
Engage actively in combat to boost your damage output and parry attacks to regain stamina to keep up the pace. Modify your build with Rings and Brooches to optimise your playstyle

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011274/30aff708d5d3c999e1c3fd5543762d54b85ff334.png"][/img]DENSE LEVEL DESIGN 
Overcome adversity in whichever method you desire. Inspired by the complex level design of earlier souls games, PRISON OF HUSKS aims to recapture the magic of wandering a compact and dense world full of shortcuts that loop back on themselves. Uncover secrets in every nook.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011274/b4e08caa18602b4c400429a282b606873e02dc8c.png"][/img]
BREAK HEARTS, RESTORE LOVE[/p][p]Challenge fearless hoarders of pigment whose desires stand in your way and defeat them in whichever order you wish.[/p][p]As you search for your dear, you may assist others whose hearts ache and restore love. However you will also face off against bosses whose desires for one another stand in your way.

[/p]

notes.title: We're Funded + Development is going well :]
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

I just wanted to make a post to say thank you for your support so far, it’s very cool to see. At the end of 2024 we were funded by WINGS and as of the past week, we just passed our first funding milestone, AND are just passing 20k wishlists, which is so amazing! I’ve been working hard on the game with a couple contractors: [url=https://x.com/apnoiac]APNOIAC[/url] and [url=https://moonskinned.co.uk]Moonskinned[/url]; you should check out their work! They’re both very talented people.

Wish we could show more, but for now, here’s like a couple snippets of things in development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011274/e7e4ca78783592b555ac2d11b8ed912b7048b58a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45011274/0f3b226e5c2bdf22c7467214a3e7446e58729c82.png[/img]

We also have a [url=https://discord.gg/7qwhs2UHhA][b]discord[/b][/url] if you would like to see any minor updates or engage with other people interested in the game. Some people even made fan art, which is crazy to me.

Anyways til next time!
-Tammy
